subject: Follow-up: Model mix & token volumes (post-demo)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Turner <emily.turner@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: Model mix & token volumes (post-demo)

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap + next steps so we have alignment heading into procurement:

TL;DR ask: if you can confirm monthly token volumes by model (chat, embeddings, rerank) and an approximate target budget range, we can propose a model-mix pricing sheet and a 3-month committed capacity option with target $/1M-token tiers.

Recap from our call:
- Primary workload: user-facing chat assistant (support + guided workflows) — latency-sensitive; expect a higher share of chat tokens.
- Secondary: embeddings for semantic search (batch & nearline indexing) — tolerant of lower-cost model variants.
- Tertiary: reranking for search results (on-demand, lower qps but high-quality model).

What we need from you to build a concrete pricing proposal:
1) Expected monthly token volumes broken down by model type (approx is fine): chat (prompt + reply tokens), embeddings (tokens for indexing per month), rerank (tokens per request).
2) Target budget range for inference (monthly) — helps us choose between Hosted vs Dedicated capacity sizing and commit-level discounts.
3) Any constraints: preferred model family (open models vs specific vendor), region, or compliance requirements.

Attachments: I attached a quick token-estimates template (BrightLayer_Token_Volumes_20260214.xlsx) to make it easy to drop in numbers.

Proposed next steps:
- Emily: fill the sheet and send back by EOD Monday (2/16) — we’ll use that to build the $/1M-token tiers and a recommended model mix.
- Rishi: I’ll loop you in for the pricing calc and Dedicated sizing if the volumes look like a fit.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15-min follow-up if easier.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: BrightLayer_Token_Volumes_20260214.xlsx

From: Emily Turner <emily.turner@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightLayer Legal <legal@brightlayer.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Model mix & token volumes (post-demo)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the template — helps a lot. I filled the sheet with our current best estimates (see attached). Key notes:

- Chat: ~120M tokens/month (70% prompts from users, 30% model responses). Peak qps during business hours ~250 r/s; SLA expectations: p99 latency < 500ms for the assistant.
- Embeddings: incremental indexing workload ~5M text items/month -> ~15M tokens/month (batch jobs overnight acceptable).
- Rerank: low-volume, ~1.2M tokens/month but the quality bar is high for search relevancy.
- Budget: internally we’re targeting $8k–$12k/month initially for inference, but we have flexibility if the unit economics make sense for committed capacity.

Open questions from our side:
1) For embeddings, can you confirm cost-optimal model suggestions (quantized options) and expected $/1M tokens?
2) What does Redwood recommend for model mix to meet the p99 latency target while keeping within our budget range?

I attached the filled template (BrightLayer_Token_Volumes_20260214.xlsx). Legal is cc’d in case they need to start procurement steps.

Thanks,
Emily Turner
Head of Product
BrightLayer
emily.turner@brightlayer.com

Attachments: BrightLayer_Token_Volumes_20260214.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Turner <emily.turner@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Model mix & token volumes (post-demo)

Great, Emily — really appreciate the prompt turnaround and the detail. Based on your numbers, here’s an initial proposal and the unit economics we’ll use to build a formal quote: 

Summary of volumes you provided:
- Chat: 120M tokens/month
- Embeddings (batch): 15M tokens/month
- Rerank: 1.2M tokens/month
- Total: ~136.2M tokens/month

Model mix recommendation (proposal):
- Chat (latency-sensitive): 75% of chat volume on a low-latency chat model (Redwood-verified optimized LLM) + 25% on a cost-tier fallback for background tasks.
- Embeddings: use an efficient quantized embedding model for 100% of embedding calls (batch indexing overnight) — lower $/1M tokens.
- Rerank: high-quality rerank model (smaller qps) to preserve relevance.

Target unit economics (ballpark, before commit discounts):
- Chat (low-latency): $6.00 per 1M tokens
- Chat (fallback/cost tier): $2.50 per 1M tokens
- Embeddings (quantized): $1.20 per 1M tokens
- Rerank (high-quality): $4.50 per 1M tokens

Using the proposed split, estimated monthly cost (no commit):
- Chat: 120M tokens * [0.75*$6 + 0.25*$2.5] per 1M tokens = approx $570/month* (Note: calculation below)
  - Effective chat $/1M = 0.75*6 + 0.25*2.5 = 4.75 -> cost = 120 * 4.75 = $570
- Embeddings: 15 * 1.2 = $18
- Rerank: 1.2 * 4.5 = $5.4
- Total (list pricing): ~$593.40/month

This list-pricing number is well below your stated budget range — which likely means one of these data points is off or we’re misaligning units (invoiceable units could be tokens vs embedding vectors depending on model). Important to confirm: when you say $8k–$12k/month, is that exclusively for inference spend or does it include engineering/ops costs? If $8k–$12k is inference-only, then we should be sizing differently (you may have higher monthly volumes or additional features like streaming and multimodal that increase token usage).

Next steps:
- Rishi: can you validate the unit economics above (especially chat effective $/1M calc) and flag whether Dedicated/reserved capacity pricing would better match BrightLayer’s budget envelope? If we can get to a 3–6 month commit the effective $/1M can drop significantly (I’ll include tiered commit numbers).
- Emily: could you confirm whether the $8k–$12k budget is for inference alone and whether you expect growth in the first quarter (we should model month-over-month growth if so)? Also confirm any compliance/region constraints.

I’ll draft a short pricing sheet and an optional 3-month reserved capacity proposal once Rishi signs off on the unit economics.

Thanks — we can do 20 min today at 11:30 PT if you’re free to walk through numbers.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_Draft_BrightLayer_v1.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Model mix & token volumes (post-demo)

Thanks for pulling this together, Marissa — quick notes from infra/pricing: 

- The list unit economics look reasonable as a starting point but the chat number seems low given typical token accounting (we should confirm whether BrightLayer’s chat numbers are modelling both prompt+response tokens). If they already lumped prompt+response into 120M, your math is fine.
- Dedicated reserved capacity: for ~120M chat tokens + embedding batch, we can propose a small Dedicated pool. With a 3-month commit we can target 25–35% off list $/1M depending on model family and quantization. That would put effective chat $/1M in the $3.90–$5.00 range for the low-latency model.
- For embeddings: quantized batch pipelines can hit sub-$1.00 /1M for large volumes; for 15M it’s closer to $1.00–$1.15 /1M.

Action: I’ll prepare a quick tiered pricing worksheet with: list pricing, 3-month commit, and 12-month commit scenarios and send before EOD. Marissa — once that’s in place we can include a minimal SOW and then Legal can start procurement.

-Rishi
